rust_summary: the texture hosts an account may load from, answered by a mod before the game's own list (`native_account_texture_uris`).
doc_summary: `native_account_texture_uris(uris)` runs before the game chooses the texture URL templates it may load: the first mod to answer sets `uris`, and the game uses them instead. Bundles need "hooks": @API:account_texture_uris@.
